speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mistress. I go at first light. I would not have you hear the hour from the stair.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You told me yesterday that you go. You are telling me the hour, which is the part I did not have. Say it once more.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: First light. I shall not be at breakfast, and I shall not be at the door for a name.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse. The hour, out loud. I will not have it only in his mouth.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: First light. I have it in my ear. I have not got it on a paper, and I do not need one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The chamber aired. The coffer unvisited. I have not a key, and I shall not grow one while you are on a river.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gib.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Off the lord's book. I said so yesterday. I do not say a thing twice so that it may be doubted.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can put him on the bed. I cannot read whose book it is. I know that book by the size of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The large one stays. So do the pages under the board. Neither goes in the boat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I shall not dust them into a better place. A page that is moved is a page that is lost, and I am not your clerk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two shirts go. One is the shirt Jacqueline named. The grey cloak goes. That is all the baggage the house needs.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The house needs the hour, and it has it. Twenty shillings is already in my book. Do not bring the quarter to the stair in the dark to pay it again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. The twenty are paid. I am not carrying the coffer, and I am not counting it tonight.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The latch shut when I tried it. I counted one shut. I did not count a coin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One shut is enough. If the baker is short in the morning, leave it short. I will not be here to measure a loaf.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is short whether you are here or not. Two fingers and a thumb was Sunday. I have not grown it back, and I will not pretend to.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will set bread where a man can see it if he comes down. If he does not come down, the mice will not have a feast of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the house is told. God keep you, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: God keep you. Come back wet if the river is wet. I did not undertake the weather yesterday, and I do not undertake it now.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: First light. I will say it once on the stair, and I will not write it.
